explanation: Accumulate the source digits into an integer, then recursively divide by the destination base and append remainders while unwinding. Python integers avoid fixed-width overflow.
timeComplexity: O(d²+e²) conservative bit/string work for d source and e result digits
spaceComplexity: O(d+e²) conservative bits/characters for recursive integer states and output
